This is an important outage update from Mohave Electric Cooperative. Due to the extent of the damage from the storm, restoration efforts could now take to 48 hours. This is our current estimate, and the restoration time may change as repairs progress.
We understand the challenges of being without electricity for an extended period and appreciate your patience as crews work to safely restore power. If you or someone in your household experiences a medical emergency or is in immediate danger, please call 911.
We will continue providing updates as more information becomes available.
